transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, well, what made me ask for help is I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to really like... and I end up throwing most of it away. I don't know, I just can't bring myself to eat it.
Are you avoiding eating because you’re worried about gaining weight?

No, it's not that. I'm not really worried about my weight at all. It's just... I don't know, I just don't have an appetite. The food just doesn't seem appealing to me right now, even if it's something I usually like.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed feeling sad, if that's what you mean. I just... I go to work at the store, do my shifts, and come home. I wouldn't really say I've been feeling depressed, just kind of blank, I guess.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I guess I have. Um, I used to get really excited about going to gallery nights, or playing basketball... even just grabbing food-truck tacos or helping kids with art stuff. But lately, if I try to do any of that, I just stand there feeling totally flat. I usually end up making an excuse to leave early.
Have you been feeling down most of the day nearly every day?
No, not really. Like I said, I wouldn't say I feel down or sad. It's more just... I don't feel much of anything. I just kind of exist through the day.
Did something stressful or upsetting happen in your life around the time this started?

I'm not sure if I'd call it upsetting, exactly, but... well, this has been going on for about two months now. It started right around the time I won a window display award at the store. The district manager started giving me all this attention because of it, and... yeah, that's pretty much when this all started.
How did you feel when the district manager started giving you all that attention?

I'm not really sure. Um... I guess I didn't feel much of anything. You'd think I would be happy about it, or proud, but I don't know. It just didn't really register as a big deal to me. I just kind of kept going to work.
When something good happens, are you still able to feel pleasure?

No, not really. I used to get excited about things... like going to gallery nights, playing basketball with the guys, or even just grabbing tacos from the food trucks downtown. I also used to like helping kids out with art stuff. But lately... if I do any of that, I just stand there. I feel totally flat. I usually end up just making an excuse to leave early.
Have you been waking up much earlier than usual, even when you still want to sleep?

Yeah, actually. Most nights, I just lie in bed replaying that whole award thing in my head, thinking about the conversations at the store. And then, even if I finally manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way too early. Once I'm up, I just can't get my mind to shut back off to go back to sleep.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, I have. It's been really frustrating. At work, I keep... I just keep losing my place on really simple stuff. Like if I'm counting inventory or trying to pick out colors for a display, I just kind of blank out. I end up second-guessing myself over things I used to do fast, without even thinking about it. Now it just takes me forever to get through basic tasks.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
No, I haven't really had any thoughts like that. I mean, things have been tough, and I feel down a lot, but I don't want to hurt myself or anything. I don't think about ending it.
Have you lost weight since this started?

Yeah, I have. Actually, that's kind of what made me realize I needed to ask for help. I just... I barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, and I'll buy something I used to really like, but I just end up staring at it. I usually throw most of it away. So, yeah, I've definitely lost some weight.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed myself moving or talking any slower than normal. And nobody at work has pointed anything out to me, so... yeah, I think I'm pretty much the same in that way.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's like by the middle of a shift, my body just feels heavy. Even doing simple stuff, like straightening the racks or walking back to the stockroom, it just takes way more out of me than it should. I just feel drained.
Have these symptoms been making it hard for you to function at work or in your daily life?

Yeah, it has. I mean, I’m still going to work, but I’ve been messing up on things like inventory counts and the display plans. It's happened enough lately that my manager has actually had to start double-checking my work. 

And outside of work... I've just been skipping things. I used to go to gallery nights, play basketball, help out at these youth art workshops... but I just haven't been showing up for any of that lately.
Have you been feeling worthless or overly guilty lately?

Yeah, I have. Lately, I just... I keep thinking I don't deserve this award I got at work, or the chance to be a supervisor. I just feel this heavy guilt, like I somehow tricked everyone into thinking I'm doing a good job. People keep telling me I earned it and that I didn't trick anyone, but I just can't shake the feeling that I'm a fraud.
Have you been feeling this loss of interest and emptiness nearly every day?

Yeah, pretty much every day. Like I said, I used to get really excited about going to gallery nights, or playing basketball, or even just grabbing food-truck tacos. I used to love helping the kids with their art stuff, too. But lately... even if I do go, I just stand there feeling completely flat. I don't feel anything at all. Usually, I just end up making an excuse to leave early.
